lines.text: The sleepless king had the Book of Records read to him, and it showed Mordecai exposed a plot.
The king learned plenty had been done for Mordecai, and his attendants said Haman was standing in the court.

wrong_details.wrong: plenty had been done for Mordecai
wrong_details.true: nothing had been done for Mordecai

lines.text: Haman thought the king meant him, and proposed a royal robe, a horse, and a parade through the city square.
The king told Haman to take the robe and horse to Mordecai, and Haman paraded him while reading a royal decree.
